summary: Implemented the rich_measure/VerticalCenter feature. Changes: rich/tree.py adds Tree.__rich_measure__ (iterative stack-based walk, four cells of indent per level) and imports Measurement. rich/align.py adds Align.__repr__, Align width constraint (measured max, or min of measured max and explicit width), and the public VerticalCenter class (render with newline-segment padding from console.size.height, measurement delegation, repr, Jupyter mixin). rich/console.py sets justify="default" in print's render options. CHANGELOG.md marks 9.8.0 UNRELEASED with an Added subheading and keeps the existing entry. tests/test_align.py adds repr, render, and measure tests for VerticalCenter plus an Align repr test; tests/test_tree.py adds a tree measurement test (expects 11/19) and the Measurement import. Nothing was run and nothing was committed, per instructions, so all tests are unverified. Choices: VerticalCenter repr is VerticalCenter('foo'); the tree test uses Console() without io because test_tree.py does not import io; the tree level counter ends at -1 after the root is exhausted, which is harmless.
